purpose.zh: 活动上背的旋转，放松肩部
purpose.en: Mobilize upper-back rotation and relax the shoulders.

text.zh: 一只手掌心朝上从另一臂下方穿过
text.en: Slide one hand palm-up under your other arm

text.zh: 肩膀随之下沉，上背转动
text.en: Let that shoulder lower as your upper back rotates.

text.zh: 臀部保持在膝盖上方，再慢慢回来
text.en: Keep your hips over your knees, then come back slowly.

commonErrors.en: Shifting the hips to one side.
Twisting from the lower back instead of the upper back.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒适的程度，出现疼痛就放松
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.
